## Today {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">TUE AUG 25 · 3-5 PM</span>

Package the question, data, code, evidence, limitations, and AI assistance so another person can inspect the work.

## Minimum handoff

- One descriptive or associational question
- Source, years, unit, and indicator definitions
- One R script or Quarto notebook
- One figure or table with a careful statement
- One limitation
- One AI-use note

## A clean render is a test

```yaml
---
title: "Math Camp field notebook"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
---
```

Restart R. Render from the source. Repair hidden state.

## Four-part audit

| Pass | Core question |
|---|---|
| Reproducibility | Does it run clean? |
| Provenance | Can I trace the data? |
| Interpretation | Does the claim match the design? |
| Communication | Can a new reader follow it? |

## AI-use note

> I used [tool] to [contribution]. I provided [public context]. I verified it using [checks]. I revised or rejected [example]. I remain responsible for the analysis and interpretation.

## Lab 4 {.inverse}

<span class="kicker">MINI HACKATHON · WED AUG 26 · 4-5 PM</span>

Exchange. Run cold. Audit. Repair one high-value issue.

**Nothing is graded. A useful failure is a success.**
